output.summary: An herbaceous plant native across the Paleotropics, from tropical and southern Africa through southern and eastern Asia to Pacific islands. Usually annual but sometimes perennial in the tropics, it creeps along the ground and roots where its stems touch soil. According to one source, its young leaf tips are cooked and eaten in New Guinea.
